title: Molecular mechanism of DNA recognition by the rice zinc finger transcription factor Bsr-d1.
authors: Ji, Lifeng; Jiang, Jie; Qin, Yiling; Yi, Yaqi; Chang, Yongqi; Liu, Tian; Liu, Junfeng; Zhang, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold3结构预测与BLI实验，解析水稻锌指转录因子Bsr-d1对GTACT顺式元件的特异性识别机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作建模与关键残基验证，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The rice transcription factor bsr-d1, a zinc finger protein, is a target for Magnaporthe oryzae pathogenesis, activating the expression of peroxidase genes and suppressing H(2)O(2) generated in rice immunity. However, the specific recognition mechanism of Bsr-d1 and its target DNA is unknown. Here, with the structural prediction using AlphaFold3, we demonstrate that Bsr-d1 contains two Cys2-His2 zinc finger domains (ZF1:73-97 and ZF2:135-159) connected via an extended loop. Gel filtration and bio-layer interferometry (BLI) assays revealed that ZF1, but not ZF2, specifically binds the GTACT cis-element in peroxidase gene promoters. Guided by these findings, we propose an AlphaFold3-derived interaction model of the DNA/bsr-d1 in which residues Y85 and Q86, along with three positively charged residues (K92, R96, K97), are positioned close proximity to DNA binding sites. Functional validation showed that alanine substitutions at Y85, Q86, K92, R96 or K97 significantly disrupted DNA binding, while mutations in the GTACT motif of promoter region abolished Bsr-d1/promoter interaction. Collectively, our findings elucidate the structural basis of zinc finger-DNA recognition in plant immunity and establish a framework for engineering Bsr-d1 to confer rice broad-spectrum resistance.
abstract_zh: 水稻转录因子bsr-d1是一种锌指蛋白，是稻瘟病菌（Magnaporthe oryzae）致病性的靶标，激活过氧化物酶基因的表达并抑制水稻免疫中产生的H(2)O(2)。然而，Bsr-d1与其靶DNA的特异性识别机制尚不清楚。在此，通过使用AlphaFold3的结构预测，我们证明Bsr-d1包含两个Cys2-His2锌指结构域（ZF1:73-97和ZF2:135-159），它们通过一个延伸环连接。凝胶过滤和生物层干涉（BLI）实验揭示，ZF1（而非ZF2）特异性结合过氧化物酶基因启动子中的GTACT顺式元件。基于这些发现，我们提出了一个AlphaFold3衍生的DNA/bsr-d1相互作用模型，其中残基Y85和Q86，以及三个带正电荷的残基（K92、R96、K97），位于接近DNA结合位点的位置。功能验证表明，Y85、Q86、K92、R96或K97处的丙氨酸替换显著破坏了DNA结合，而启动子区域GTACT基序的突变则消除了Bsr-d1/启动子相互作用。总体而言，我们的发现阐明了植物免疫中锌指-DNA识别的结构基础，并为工程化Bsr-d1以赋予水稻广谱抗性建立了框架。
